title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Booking the Delayed Price Carry a Member Owes
content:
Where a member has held bushels in the unpriced position on Grain Marketing Contracts, the carry they owe for holding them is put onto the settlement statement those bushels were drawn onto. The result governed is the carry a member owes on bushels that stood unpriced, carried as a delayed price service charge on the member's grain ledger against the named contract and statement.

**Capability.** The call adds one charge line to the member's grain ledger against the named contract and statement, carrying the amount supplied as a delayed price service charge; no other line is touched, and a line already standing is left exactly as it is.

**How it is invoked.** The recorded act is `book_delayed_price_carry_charge_ebb3e3fc`. It is not among the desk's listed tools: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**The parameters it takes.**

- `contract_id` — the internal reference of the grain marketing contract the unpriced bushels belong to; it identifies one contract record and is reachable from the grain contract lookup for the member before this call.
- `customer_id` — the internal reference of the member whose ledger carries the charge; it identifies one membership record and is reachable from the membership profile lookup before this call.
- `contract_number` — the contract number the member quotes when hauling or pricing, which identifies the same marketing contract on paper; it is reachable from the grain contract lookup for the member before this call.
- `settlement_number` — the settlement statement the charge line is carried on, written as S- followed by six digits, for example S-551903, in upper case with the hyphen and with no spaces; it is never left blank.
- `carry_charge_amount_usd` — the money withheld on this charge line, in USD to 2 decimal places, as a positive number with no currency symbol and no thousands separator, rounded half away from zero at the cent when a longer value is supplied.

**What comes back.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the ledger line reference minted for the charge, the settlement statement it was carried on, and the amount booked in USD to 2 decimal places; that sentence, rather than an error text, is what indicates the charge line was added.

**Observable effect.** On success the charge shows on the member's grain ledger under that statement number.
